# Constraints

The defaults every product repository starts with. Generated from `internal/config/defaults.toml`, the
configuration embedded in the binary, by `go generate ./...`; do not edit by hand. A repository changes them in
`.aayudha/config.toml`, which is a protected path. The Quality Architect seat owns these thresholds; the AI Native
Engineer executes `verify` against them. Changing a default regenerates this file, which is also a protected path.

Source: a WP means docs/BUILD-PLAN.md fixes the value there; "proposed (WP0.5)" means the plan names the key but not
its value, and WP0.5 chose it.

`aayu ready <feature> --check` shows each part's drift from its pins when it is read; nothing writes a drift record. A new version's hash covers its changes and the review findings it fixes, so a reason edited after a person saw it baselines nothing.

## Approve to build

| Key | Default | Meaning | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| `critique.review_wait_hours` | `24` | Hours after the seats' reviews of a Feature's baselines were asked for that Approve to build (`aayu ready <feature>`) opens with some of them not in. Before that it waits for every review. An open gap keeps it off at any time. | 0.4 |

Approve to build is a person's decision, through GitHub's device flow every time. It is off while a needed part of the Feature is not approved or has drifted, the Feature has no Initiative parent, a review gap is open, or some reviews are not in and fewer than `critique.review_wait_hours` have passed since they were asked for. The record is `specs/<feature>/approved.json` on the `ledger` branch.

## Outcomes

| Key | Default | Meaning | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outcomes.session_gap_minutes` | `10` | A gap of more than this many minutes between two human-identity actions in the actions log on the `ledger` branch starts a new founder session. | 0.4 |
| `outcomes.action_minutes` | `2` | Minutes each founder session adds for its last action, on top of its span from its first action to its last. | 0.4 |

`aayu measure` reads `aayu:founder_minutes_per_pr` as the sum of the founder sessions in the window divided by the pull requests merged into the integration branch in it. It is a proxy: it counts time in aayu's recorded human actions, not time spent elsewhere. Bot and human-fallback records never count; a window with no merged pull request has no value.

## Design review

|---|---|---|---|
| `review.figma_diff_max` | `2.0` | Largest share of pixels, in percent, a prototype screenshot may differ from its Figma frame after the anti-aliasing mask. Colour and typography token mismatches are counted separately and must be zero. | WP6.5 |
| `review.baseline` | `["/"]` | URL paths on the `[verify.environments]` target that `baseline` captures for each commit. | proposed (WP6.6) |

`review` runs lane A (the ui-review model) k = 3 times per state and counts a finding only when 2 of 3 runs report it at Nielsen severity 2 or more; lane B (impeccable, axe, focus-indicator and target-size probes) is deterministic, and its findings cannot be overridden by lane A (ground rule 7). These are fixed by the plan (WP6.6), not configuration.
